carpet.floooring: Gustav "Brick" Floooring arrived on Day 4 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Gustav "Brick" Floooring shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
christianbarefoot3440: Bastian Christianbar, a farmhand from Northwick, was sent forward on Day 5 to fill a gap in S-F1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
dravci85: Bram "Ghost" Dravci took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
The First Wave ribbon marked Bram "Ghost" Dravci as an early volunteer. At S-F14, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Bram "Ghost" Dravci wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Bram "Ghost" Dravci watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
Bram "Ghost" Dravci sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking.
